WITH l AS (SELECT 1 AS k, 10 AS v UNION ALL SELECT 2,NULL UNION ALL SELECT 9,90 UNION ALL SELECT NULL,40), r AS (SELECT 1 AS k, 3 AS v UNION ALL SELECT 1,NULL UNION ALL SELECT 2,5 UNION ALL SELECT 8,80 UNION ALL SELECT NULL,99) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n,COUNT(l.v) AS lc,COUNT(r.v) AS rc,SUM(l.v) AS ls,SUM(r.v) AS rs FROM l INNER JOIN r ON l.k=r.k

WITH l AS (SELECT 1 AS k, 10 AS v UNION ALL SELECT 2,NULL UNION ALL SELECT 9,90 UNION ALL SELECT NULL,40), r AS (SELECT 1 AS k, 3 AS v UNION ALL SELECT 1,NULL UNION ALL SELECT 2,5 UNION ALL SELECT 8,80 UNION ALL SELECT NULL,99) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n,COUNT(r.v) AS c,SUM(r.v) AS s FROM l LEFT JOIN r ON l.k IS NOT DISTINCT FROM r.k
